problems.explain: Divide top and bottom by anything they share, and keep going: 10/20 ÷ 2 gives 5/10, then ÷ 5 gives 1/2. Only 1 divides both 1 and 2, so stop at 1/2. Dividing by 10, the greatest common factor, does it in one step.
